content_neutrality.statement: This contract defines envelopes, identities, invariants, and error semantics only. It deliberately fixes no topology, no node or effect content, no point awards, caps, costs, migration outcomes, or balance.
content_neutrality.owner_pending_route: OI-004 (authoritative passive-tree source), then owner-approved content tables; smallest future path is a versioned, machine-readable graph document plus an owner-controlled balance table consumed by this contract unchanged.
content_neutrality.synthetic_identifier_rule: Every identifier and placeholder value in this contract and its fixtures is obviously synthetic (n:000, e:000, v:0 style) and carries no player-facing content.

counter_separation.invariant: The persistent commission-chain counter and the live tree-budget counter are structurally distinct ledgers. They may never be collapsed into one field, derived from each other, or given new semantics by this contract or any implementation of it.
counter_separation.persistent_commission_points: quests.questPoints - persistent commission-chain record counter. Survives plain re-login in the browser authority. Canonical increment sources, caps, and reset rule are OWNER_PENDING (unresolved cross-stack divergence recorded as QP-2 by TASK-0105).
counter_separation.live_tree_points: Top-level live session tree-budget counter feeding the earned-points calculation. Persistence/reset semantics diverge between browser and native stacks; canonical semantics OWNER_PENDING (same QP-2 route).

graph_version.description: Monotonically increasing content-generation version owned by the authoritative source. Observed current value in both live stacks is 2 (src/core/passives/verdigris-geometric-tree.js VERDIGRIS_PASSIVE_TREE_SCHEMA_VERSION; native networking.cpp passive_tree_json). The contract does not pin the value; implementations read it from the approved content source.

origin.description: Stable node_id of the single mandatory root every allocation must include and connect to. The literal id string is OWNER_PENDING content (browser currently uses a coordinate-pair id).

visibility_rules.description: Rules that gate which nodes may be allocated (browser precedent: locked outer-circle/subtree nodes cannot be allocated). Rule shapes and content OWNER_PENDING via OI-004.

node_id.description: Opaque, stable, unique identity assigned by the approved content source. The contract never interprets node_id structure; consumers must not parse meaning out of it (the native axis-score walk that parses ids is a named negative control).
node_id.pattern_note: No structural pattern is imposed so that any future owner-chosen identifier scheme fits without a contract change.

content.description: All gameplay meaning: attribute bindings, effect bindings, costs, visibility class, display data. Entirely OWNER_PENDING; this contract neither enumerates nor constrains these fields beyond requiring they be data, not code.

forbidden_interpretations: Deriving attributes or effects from the textual form of node_id (native +2/axis walk is a negative control, never an accepted authority).
Assigning default costs or effects when the owner table omits them.

variants.description: Opaque variant identifiers for the connection choice (browser precedent: conduit variants selectable at allocation time). Variant meanings are OWNER_PENDING content.

cost.description: Per-choice cost is OWNER_PENDING balance; the current observed convention (one point per chosen edge) is recorded in REPORT.md as provenance, not fixed here.

allocated_nodes.description: Node identities claimed as allocated. Must contain origin exactly once (duplicates are DUPLICATE_NODE); every entry must exist in the referenced graph (UNKNOWN_NODE); every entry must be connected to origin through allocated nodes only (DISCONNECTED_ALLOCATION).

items.description: Selected variant per chosen edge. Unknown edge_id, unknown variant, duplicate edge_id, or endpoints outside the allocated set are MALFORMED_EDGE / DISCONNECTED_ALLOCATION respectively.

selected_node.description: Currently highlighted node; if present it must be an allocated node id, otherwise the authority falls back to origin (browser precedent).

calling_order.description: Ordered list of allocated calling/class node ids (browser wire key classOrder). Entries must all be allocated calling-class nodes; ordering semantics OWNER_PENDING.

allocation.trust_boundary: An allocation claim is an untrusted request. The authority rebuilds validity from the approved graph and budget context; it never trusts a previously stored blob in place of validation.

persistent_commission_points.lifecycle: persists across plain re-login in the current browser authority
persistent_commission_points.semantics: increment sources, caps, and reset rule are OWNER_PENDING (unresolved cross-stack divergence recorded as QP-2 by TASK-0105)
persistent_commission_points.collapse_rule: MUST NEVER be merged with, aliased to, or derived from live_tree_points

live_tree_points.ledger: live session tree-budget counter feeding the earned-points calculation
live_tree_points.wire_identity: top-level live tree-budget counter (browser Player.questPoints analogue)
live_tree_points.lifecycle: persistence/reset semantics diverge between browser and native stacks
live_tree_points.semantics: canonical semantics OWNER_PENDING (same QP-2 route); observed formulas documented in REPORT.md as provenance only
live_tree_points.collapse_rule: MUST NEVER be merged with, aliased to, or derived from persistent_commission_points

persistent_commission_points.description: Balance of the persistent commission-chain ledger (quests.questPoints). Distinct field, distinct lifecycle; never interchangeable with live_tree_points.

live_tree_points.description: Balance of the live session tree-budget ledger feeding earned calculation. Distinct field, distinct lifecycle; never interchangeable with persistent_commission_points.

earned.description: Total spendable points derived by the authority from level plus exactly one designated tree-budget counter input. The derivation formula, caps, and which counter feeds it are OWNER_PENDING (QP-2); observed formulas on both stacks are documented in REPORT.md as provenance only.

spent.description: Points consumed by the allocation claim under owner-approved cost rules (observed convention: one per non-origin node plus one per chosen edge).

unspent.description: Non-negative remainder; a negative result must surface as OVERSPENT, never clamp silently (the silent-clamp behaviour of the native approximation is part of the named negative control).

invariants: persistent_commission_points and live_tree_points are separate ledgers; collapsing them in any payload, persistence record, or API is COUNTER_CONFUSION.
No cap, award, or cost constant is embedded in this contract; all numeric balance lives in owner-controlled tables (OWNER_PENDING).

element.description: Stable identity of the first offending element under the deterministic tie-break (lexicographic by identity), or null for envelope-level failures.

message_key.description: Stable lookup key for presentation text; wording is presentation-layer and OWNER_PENDING.

errors.ordering: Ascending by validation rank (see VALIDATION.md), then lexicographic by element. Deterministic regardless of input order.

accepted_snapshot.description: Present only when ok=true: the canonical rebuilt state (mirrors allocation envelope plus resolved budget numbers). This snapshot is authoritative output, never trusted input.

strategy.description: revalidate_in_place: migrate structural form, then run normal validation. full_refund_reset: discard the old allocation and grant a reset state (browser precedent for pre-current persisted blobs: one-time full refund, verdigris-authority.js resolvePersistedVerdigrisTree). Which strategy applies to which version transition is OWNER_PENDING.

rules: A version with a registered strategy migrates before validation; outcome selection is OWNER_PENDING per transition.
A version below the declared migration floor, or above any registered path, raises UNSUPPORTED_MIGRATION instead of guessing.
Migration never rewrites history silently: the pre-migration graph_version is retained in the persistence envelope audit field.

authority.description: Identifier of the validating authority instance/build.

result.description: The validation_result emitted when this blob was last rebuilt.

properties.trust_boundary: Snapshots are not trusted save blobs. A persistence write is legal only for a blob carrying validation_provenance from the authority; a raw client payload must be rejected/rebuilt first. Storing client payloads verbatim is forbidden.
properties.negative_control: native/src/networking.cpp handle_skilltree_save stores the client snapshot verbatim with no schema/budget/connectivity checks (TASK-0105 raw-snapshot trust gap). This contract forbids that shape of trust; see fixtures case NEG-010.

negative_controls.name: native_plus_two_axis_walk
negative_controls.definition: native/src/networking.cpp tree_attributes approximates attribute identity by parsing 'q,r'-style ids and awarding a flat bonus per allocated node along the best-scoring axis (STUB NOTE at networking.cpp:818-821).
negative_controls.status: NON-AUTHORITATIVE; named negative control. Never promoted to accepted authority by this contract or any consumer of it.

negative_controls.name: native_raw_snapshot_save
negative_controls.definition: native/src/networking.cpp handle_skilltree_save persists client snapshots verbatim without validation.
negative_controls.status: NON-AUTHORITATIVE; named negative control (raw-snapshot trust gap identified by TASK-0105).

negative_controls.name: counter_collapse
negative_controls.definition: Any merge, aliasing, or mutual derivation of quests.questPoints and the live tree-budget counter.
negative_controls.status: FORBIDDEN under COUNTER_CONFUSION regardless of stack.

versioning_policy.contract_version_semantics: schema_version follows semver; additive envelope fields are minor, breaking envelope changes are major and require a migration entry.
versioning_policy.compatibility: Implementations declare which contract schema_version they implement; unknown newer contracts must fail closed with UNKNOWN_GRAPH_VERSION on the graph space and UNSUPPORTED_MIGRATION on the persistence space.
